jobs.title: Research Scientist, AI
jobs.description:
**Company**
-----------

Pramaana Labs is a frontier AI lab building the verification layer for AI. We turn complex human knowledge, including tax codes, legal rules, clinical guidelines and security protocols, into formal representations that support reasoning people can inspect and check. Our architecture pairs models trained to formalize and reason with a symbolic world model encoded in Lean 4. Founded in 2025 and headquartered in Palo Alto, Pramaana brings together researchers and formal methods experts from Google, DeepMind, and Glean.

**The Role**
------------

We’re training models to formalize complex knowledge and reason with symbolic world models. As a Research Scientist focused on AI, you’ll develop approaches that improve the accuracy, coverage, efficiency, and generalization of our domain formalizer, autoformalizer, and prover.

Your scope spans model training, data quality, representations, and evaluation. You’ll work with an RL Scientist on reinforcement-learning approaches, Research Engineers on reliable experimentation, and Formal Methods experts on whether model outputs faithfully represent the source knowledge.

**What You'll Do**

* Lead ambitious research at the intersection of foundation models, formal reasoning, and verification, advancing Pramaana's mission to make AI reasoning reliable across complex, real-world domains.
* Develop novel model training and post-training approaches for translating complex domain knowledge into structured representations and enabling precise, verifiable reasoning.
* Drive hands-on research in reinforcement learning, synthetic data generation, reasoning, and agentic AI, exploring new techniques to advance model capabilities, generalization, and efficiency.
* Own and lead end-to-end research initiatives, identifying high-impact directions, setting technical strategy, and guiding teams of researchers and engineers while remaining deeply involved in the technical work.
* Develop rigorous benchmarks and evaluation methodologies to measure reasoning capabilities, robustness, and generalization, using experimental insights to drive fundamental model improvements.
* Partner closely with engineering to translate research breakthroughs into production capabilities, delivering measurable improvements in the performance and reliability of Pramaana's technology.

**You Will Thrive in This Role If You Have**

* A demonstrated track record of high-impact research, including research projects that have been successfully deployed and materially advanced a product, core technology, or organization's capabilities and direction.
* Deep hands-on experience in foundation model training and post-training, including one or more of large-scale pretraining, reinforcement learning, reasoning-focused training, or synthetic data generation.
* Strong technical depth in modern AI research, including frontier language models, agentic systems, multi-step reasoning, or structured prediction.
* Proficiency in Python and modern ML frameworks such as PyTorch or JAX, with experience implementing and scaling training experiments.
* Exceptional research judgment and experimental rigor, with the ability to identify promising directions, formulate hypotheses, design meaningful evaluations, and distinguish genuine advances from incremental gains.
* Demonstrated technical leadership and independence, with experience driving ambitious research initiatives, mentoring scientists, and collaborating effectively across research and engineering while remaining a strong individual contributor.

**Especially Strong Candidates May Also Have**

* Direct experience training or post-training frontier-scale models, including distributed training, large-scale reinforcement learning, or inference-time scaling.
* Research experience in neuro-symbolic AI, autoformalization, automated theorem proving, program synthesis, or formal verification.
* A strong research record demonstrated through influential publications, deployed research breakthroughs, or substantial improvements to state-of-the-art model capabilities.

jobs.title: Research Engineer
jobs.description:
**Company**
-----------

Pramaana Labs is a frontier AI lab building the verification layer for AI. Founded in 2025 and headquartered in Palo Alto, we turn complex human knowledge, including tax codes, legal rules, clinical guidelines and security protocols, into a formal representation, so every AI answer can be traced, challenged, and proved. Pramaana's architecture pairs foundation models trained to formalize and reason with a symbolic world model encoded in Lean 4. Pramaana was founded by a team out of Google, DeepMind, and Glean, combining frontier AI researchers and formal methods experts.

**The Role**
------------

We’re looking for a Research Engineer to build and improve the systems that turn complex knowledge into formal representations and use them to reason and prove. You’ll work closely with researchers and formal methods engineers on Pramaana’s domain formalizer, autoformalizer, and prover, making these systems more accurate, repeatable, and efficient.

This is a hands-on role combining software engineering with careful experimentation. Your work could include building model and tool orchestration, improving evaluation, developing data pipelines and training environments, or implementing new representations. You’ll own a focused workstream based on your strengths and the team’s needs, with room to contribute across the research stack.

You’ll take ideas from an initial experiment to a tested implementation, investigate failures, and measure whether changes improve correctness, coverage, latency, and cost.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Build next-generation neuro-symbolic AI systems at the intersection of foundation models, formal methods, automated reasoning, and verification.
* Design rigorous evaluation frameworks and research benchmarks to study reasoning capabilities, generalization, robustness, and computational efficiency.
* Develop advanced post-training and data synthesis pipelines, exploring techniques in synthetic data generation, reinforcement learning, and model self-improvement.
* Research and implement approaches to knowledge representation, compositional reasoning, program synthesis, and constraint-based inference for complex real-world domains.
* Drive end-to-end research and engineering, from rapid prototyping and controlled experimentation to ablation studies, performance optimization, and scalable production systems.

**You Will Thrive in This Role If You Have**
--------------------------------------------

* Strong software engineering fundamentals and hands-on experience building large-scale ML systems, research infrastructure, or high-performance training pipelines.
* Experience training or post-training large foundation models, including distributed training, fine-tuning, reinforcement learning, and large-scale experimentation.
* Deep proficiency in Python and modern ML frameworks, such as PyTorch, JAX, DeepSpeed, FSDP, Megatron-LM, or equivalent distributed training and inference infrastructure.
* Experience building agentic AI systems, including tool use, multi-step reasoning, agent orchestration, and evaluation of complex model behaviors.
* Familiarity with modern post-training techniques, including supervised fine-tuning, reinforcement learning, preference optimization, synthetic data generation, and reasoning-focused training.
* Strong research and experimental judgment, with experience designing benchmarks, running ablation studies, analyzing model failures, and translating research ideas into measurable improvements.
* Ability to operate independently at the intersection of research and engineering, rapidly prototyping ambitious ideas and scaling successful experiments into robust systems.

**Especially Strong Candidates May Also Have**
----------------------------------------------

* Experience building autoformalization, theorem-proving, or other systems that combine models with symbolic tools.
* Experience with Lean, Coq, Isabelle, SMT solvers, compilers, or program analysis.
* Experience optimizing model inference, parallel workloads, or evaluation pipelines for speed and cost.
* Substantial research code, open-source contributions, or projects that demonstrate strong engineering and experimental work.

Prior experience in formal verification is not required. We value strong engineering, careful experimentation, and the curiosity to learn how models and formal systems work together.

* Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Data Science, Engineering, Physics, Economics, or a related quantitative field.

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* 8 years of work experience using analytics to solve product or business problems, performing statistical analysis, and coding (e.g., Python, R, SQL).
* Experience developing and using AI tools in the context of data science for large, consumer facing internet products.

**About the job**
-----------------

Android, Business, and Communications (ABC) is at the core of how people and businesses connect across the globe. Our mission is to build the world’s most helpful, expressive, and secure communication experiences. With nearly 2 billion active users on Google Messages and nearly 1 billion using the Phone app (Dialer), we ship products that make a meaningful difference in lives worldwide.

We define standard-setting "toothbrush journeys"—from fundamental calling reliability to high-resolution media sharing and expressive reactions. Beyond peer-to-peer connection, we are pioneering the next generation of conversational commerce, enabling businesses to deliver app-like experiences directly within the messaging interface. Whether adapting mobile features for a multi-device world on Wear OS or driving engagement with best-in-world features like Call Screen, we focus on high-impact innovation that connects everyone, regardless of their device.  
  
As a Data Scientist for Android and Business Communication (ABC), you will deliver critical insights, predictive models, and measurement frameworks to protect users across Rich Communication Services (RCS) and RCS Business Messaging (RBM) from spam, abuse, and malicious traffic.  
  
In this role, you will analyze complex communication data to identify emerging abuse vectors, model adversarial behaviors, and guide product and engineering teams on anti-spam and trust and safety strategies. You will bridge technical excellence and product execution by designing end-to-end classification and detection pipelines, running robust offline and online evaluations, and translating complex investigative findings into actionable recommendations that safeguard ecosystem trust and enhance the messaging experience globally.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  
  
US: $163000 - $236000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits  
  
Learn more about benefits at Google.

--------------------

* Define and track core metrics for spam prevalence, false positives, enforcement efficacy, and user impact. Develop automated dashboards, anomaly detection alerts, and reporting pipelines to monitor ecosystem health in real time.
* Design and execute A/B tests and counterfactual analyses to evaluate the efficacy and side effects of anti-spam rules, ML model updates, and UI interventions.
* Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Policy, and UX teams to identify spam trends, prioritize enforcement roadmaps, and balance security with user engagement.
* Conduct exploratory data analyses on evolving adversarial behaviors in conversational messaging and present technical insights to cross-functional stakeholders.
* Evaluate and iterate on statistical models, heuristics, and classification algorithms (e.g., text classifiers, graph signals, behavioral anomaly detection) to detect spam, phishing, and unwanted traffic across P2P RCS and commercial RBM channels.

Retail AI Foundations is part of the Retail Intelligence group within Walmart’s AI & Data organization. **The Opportunity**

As a Principal Data Scientist - Causal AI & Experimentation (within our Data Science and Machine Learning team), you will serve as a technical leader and key domain authority for advanced experimentation, measurement, and optimization solutions across the CMG organization. In this high-impact, individual-contributor role, you will bridge the gap between cutting-edge causal methodology and high-stakes business strategy. You will drive the design, development, and industrialization of enterprise-grade causal AI and statistical models that measure business impact, optimize resource allocation, and guide data-driven decision-making.

Working alongside other data scientists and engineers, you will help shape the technical strategy for measurement and experimentation initiatives. You will serve as a mentor to senior and junior data scientists, establish best-in-class modeling standards, and partner closely with cross-functional teams to deliver scalable AI solutions.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Drive the technical design and methodology for key Causal AI, measurement, and experimentation projects, translating complex business objectives into robust mathematical and algorithmic frameworks.
* Design, build, and deploy production-grade statistical, econometric, machine learning, and causal inference models (e.g., A/B & quasi-experimentation, Media/Marketing Mix Modeling, synthetic controls, uplift modeling, and non-parametric measurement).
* Develop scalable algorithms to quantify the true causal impact of promotional and non-promotional activities, generating actionable recommendations for business optimization.
* Partner closely with business and technical product managers, data engineers, ML engineers, MLOps, and commercial stakeholders to translate business priorities into scalable technical requirements and drive the end-to-end industrialization of Causal AI applications.
* Act as a technical authority and subject matter expert (SME) in Causal AI. Provide technical guidance, perform code and design reviews, and mentor team members to foster technical excellence and continuous learning.
* Translate complex causal modeling and statistical concepts into clear, compelling narratives and actionable guidance for both technical teams and non-technical business leaders.
* Stay at the forefront of academic and industry advancements in Causal AI, Causal ML, Bayesian modeling, and Generative AI, advocating for responsible AI practices and bringing novel approaches into our measurement ecosystem.

**Who You Are**

  

* You have aA Bachelor’s Degree and 8+ years of work experience, or an equivalent mix of education and work experience, is required.
* You have 8+ years of relevant industry experience in Data Science, Applied Statistics, or ML engineering with a proven track record of architecting and shipping impactful data science products.
* 5+ years of hands-on specialization in Causal Inference, Experimental Design, Measurement, and Optimization (e.g., A/B testing, quasi-experiments, observational causality, Market Mix Modeling, Bayesian modeling, uplift modeling)
* Expert-level knowledge of open-source frameworks for ML, statistics, and causal inference (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn, statsmodels, CausalML, DoWhy, EconML).
* Advanced proficiency in Python and/or R, along with strong SQL skills for complex database management and data manipulation
* Deep familiarity with open-source measurement packages (e.g., Robyn, LightweightMMM, Meridian).
* Hands-on experience scaling algorithms using big data environments (Spark, Databricks, Hadoop) and cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
* Exceptional verbal and written communication skills with a demonstrated ability to influence key partners, align business priorities, and explain complex mathematical methodologies to business leaders.
* Strong critical thinking abilities with rigorous attention to detail regarding experimental design, bias mitigation, and causal validity.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Advanced degree (MS or PhD preferred) in Statistics, Mathematics, Applied Economics, Computer Science, Data Science, or a related quantitative field with a focus on AI/ML or Causal Inference with 6+ years of relevant industry experience in Data Science, Applied Statistics, or ML engineering 6+ years with a PhD
* Experience working with complex, large-scale dataset structures in healthcare, pharmaceuticals, or highly regulated environments (including longitudinal patient-level data, syndicated sales, or promotional data).
* Familiarity or hands-on experience integrating Deep Learning or Generative AI techniques with Causal AI frameworks.
* A history of contributions to open-source data science tools or peer-reviewed publications in causal inference, experimentation, or measurement technology.

* This role is based in South San Francisco and offers a hybrid schedule working 3 day per week on campus
* Relocation benefits are **NOT** offered on this posting

ambiguous_jobs.title: Research Scientist, Robotics Data, Pretraining, DeepMind
ambiguous_jobs.description:
### **Minimum qualifications:**

* PhD in Computer Science, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Experience working with robot policy learning (e.g., imitation learning, RL) across simulators and real-world robotic platforms (e.g., dexterous manipulation, multimodal sensing).
* Experience working with simulators and robots.
* Experience contributing to research communities or efforts, including publishing papers at conferences (e.g., NeurIPS, CoRL, ICML, ICLR).

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience with systematic benchmarking, multimodal data sources, data labeling strategies, and data mixture optimization for frontier or robotics foundation models.
* Practical experience in "hill-climbing" model performance (e.g., iteratively improving data curation, training recipes, and model benchmarks).
* Proven ability to build and maintain clean research software and tools for rapid iteration on research ideas.
* A passion for bringing foundation model research from the lab to robust, real-world robotic systems.

**About the job**
-----------------

As an organization, Google maintains a portfolio of research projects driven by fundamental research, new product innovation, product contribution and infrastructure goals, while providing individuals and teams the freedom to emphasize specific types of work. As a Research Scientist, you'll setup large-scale tests and deploy promising ideas quickly and broadly, managing deadlines and deliverables while applying the latest theories to develop new and improved products, processes, or technologies. From creating experiments and prototyping implementations to designing new architectures, our research scientists work on real-world problems that span the breadth of computer science, such as machine (and deep) learning, data mining, natural language processing, hardware and software performance analysis, improving compilers for mobile platforms, as well as core search and much more.

As a Research Scientist, you'll also actively contribute to the wider research community by sharing and publishing your findings, with ideas inspired by internal projects as well as from collaborations with research programs at partner universities and technical institutes all over the world.

Our mission is to combine Gemini foundation models with physical intelligence so general-purpose robots can understand and act reliably in the real world. Critical to achieving this goal is obtaining high-quality training data and effectively integrating it into the Gemini training process. Our team's research develops data quality insights on how to best extract physical and action knowledge from robot-related datasets, and incorporates these insights into Gemini pre-training through model training and upstreaming. By pairing data ablations with fast closed-loop robot evaluations, you will shape how physical reasoning and action capabilities emerge in next-generation Gemini models and deploy onto real-world robots.

Artificial intelligence will be one of humanity’s most transformative inventions. At Google DeepMind, we are a pioneering AI lab with exceptional interdisciplinary teams focused on advancing AI development to solve complex global challenges and accelerate high-quality product innovation for billions of users. We use our technologies for widespread public benefit and scientific discovery, ensuring safety and ethics are always our highest priority.

We are pushing the boundaries across multiple domains. Our global teams offer diverse learning opportunities and varied career pathways for those driven to achieve exceptional results through collective effort.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  
  
US: $147000 - $210000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits  
  
Learn more about benefits at Google.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Develop data quality, filtering, and labeling methodologies, and optimize multimodal data representations and mixtures to upstream physical and action knowledge into Gemini pre-training.
* Design and run pre-training and policy training ablations, improve training recipes, and systematically hill-climb physical reasoning and action performance against benchmarks.
* Build and maintain the research software, evaluation tools, and lightweight post-training workflows required to iterate on research ideas quickly and verify upstream data quality through offline and closed-loop robot policy evaluations.
* Contribute to our wider research agenda—including vision-language-action (VLA) modeling, world-action models, reinforcement learning, and simulation—and communicate findings clearly in a fast-paced, collaborative team environment.

* 2 years of experience leading a research agenda.
* Experience with AI/ML technologies (e.g., frameworks for deep learning (PyTorch, TensorFlow, Jax, Ray), AI accelerators (TPUs, GPUs), model architectures (encoders, decoders, transformers), or using machine learning APIs).

* 1 year of experience leading research efforts and influencing other researchers.

-----------------

As a Research Scientist on the Graph Neural Network (GNN) team within OMEGA, you will pioneer research at the intersection of deep learning, structured data, and Large Language Models (LLMs). In this role, you will invent novel neural architectures, graph encoders, and agentic retrieval methods that bring relational reasoning to foundation models at massive scale. You will collaborate closely with partners across Google Research, Google DeepMind, and core product teams to translate theoretical breakthroughs into production-grade frameworks and next-generation AI capabilities.  

As a part of the Graph Neural Network (GNN) team, you will bridge relational structure and deep learning, making it seamless to integrate graph-structured data into neural networks and foundation models at massive scale. As a part of the team, you will conduct fundamental research and build production-grade frameworks to train and deploy these models over complex, heterogeneous graphs. Recently, the team's work has expanded into generative AI, developing structured data encoders, graph tokens, hybrid graph-sequence architectures, and graph-based retrieval and agentic systems to enhance Large Language Models (LLMs).
